items.markdown:
`No peptide is FDA-approved to regrow hair or reverse pattern baldness on its own` . Instead, peptides act as supportive, complementary agents that improve scalp health, enhance blood flow, and support follicle viability.[[1]](https://plasticsurgerykey.com/best-peptides-for-hair-growth-ranked-by-hair-specific-evidence/)[[2]](https://peptidepedia.org/guides/best-peptides-for-hair-growth)[[3]](https://www.hims.com/blog/peptides-for-hair-growth)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Juw69Q5YJqI&t=49)

- **GHK-Cu (Copper Peptide):** This tripeptide bound to copper has the strongest hair-specific evidence. It stimulates dermal papilla cells (the control center of the follicle), increases vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) to promote new blood vessel formation, and reduces scalp inflammation.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S_6OWFKA2H0&t=21)[[2]](https://plasticsurgerykey.com/best-peptides-for-hair-growth-ranked-by-hair-specific-evidence/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6srKh3veDdo&t=152)
- **Cosmetic Topical Peptides:** Ingredients like **Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3**, **Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1** , and **Oligopeptide-2** are commonly found in commercial hair serums and shampoos. They help reduce shedding, anchor the hair shaft, and prolong the anagen (growth) phase, though they are regulated as cosmetics rather than medical treatments.[[1]](https://www.hims.com/blog/peptides-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://plasticsurgerykey.com/best-peptides-for-hair-growth-ranked-by-hair-specific-evidence/)[[3]](https://omiwellbeauty.com/blogs/hair/can-peptides-really-help-your-hair-grow)
- **Growth Hormone Secretagogues (e.g., Ipamorelin + CJC-1295):** These systemic/injectable peptides raise insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1) levels, which can indirectly support follicle cycling, though they require strict monitoring and carry a high degree of social-media overhype compared to human clinical data.[[1]](https://peptidepedia.org/guides/best-peptides-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/41iaD_5gu_w)
- **BPC-157 and TB-500:** Often discussed for general tissue repair and anti-inflammation, these lack direct, robust clinical evidence for human hair regrowth.[[1]](https://www.ikclinics.co.uk/peptide-therapy/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/41iaD_5gu_w)[[3]](https://peptidepedia.org/guides/best-peptides-for-hair-growth)

### Role in Hair Restoration

- **Not a DHT Blocker:** Peptides do not block dihydrotestosterone (DHT), the primary hormone responsible for androgenetic alopecia (male and female pattern baldness).
- **Best Used as Add-Ons:** They work best alongside proven medical treatments like **minoxidil** or **finasteride** rather than replacing them.
- **Timeline:** Visible improvements in hair thickness or reduced shedding typically require **3 to 6 months** of consistent application.[[1]](https://www.hims.com/blog/peptides-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S_6OWFKA2H0&t=21)[[3]](https://peptidepedia.org/guides/best-peptides-for-hair-growth)
